kitDescription: Modernia is a Pilgrim Fire machine-gun Attacker whose damage comes from sheer volume of fire. Every bullet that lands adds a small extra hit worth 3.05% of her final ATK, and every 200 hits she gains a stack of Critical Damage ▲14.25% (up to 5, 10s each) — paid for with a matching Max Ammunition ▼5.04% per stack, which shrinks her 300-round belt toward ~225 and makes her reload more often. Whenever the team enters Full Burst she gives every ally Hit Rate ▲8.56% for 15 seconds, and while that accuracy status is running, each further 200 hits also grants herself ATK ▲29.38% for 10 seconds. Her Burst III lengthens the team's Full Burst by 5 seconds and puts her into Destroy Mode for 15 seconds: unlimited ammunition (no reloads at all), extended line of sight with auto-aim that treats the stage target as one enemy regardless of parts, and an extra 2.24% of final ATK riding her fire. The practical shape is a ramping DPS whose best stretch is her own burst window, where no-reload uptime, maxed crit-damage stacks and the Destroy Mode rider all overlap.

redAssertions: S2a 'is a live team damage buff (zeroing it lowers her AND at least one teammate)' — expect(BASE.total > NO_HITRATE.total) fails; modernia's total is byte-identical with hitRatePct zeroed. CLASSIFIED RECON_ERROR: game-mechanics.md §7 states MG/SR/RL keep the flat base core rate and have no accuracy circle, so the HR→core lift is wired only for AR/SMG/SG. The line is encoded faithfully (fullBurstEnter / allies / 8.56 / 15s — every structural S5 assertion on it PASSED) and is live for the AR/SMG consumer in the fixture (liter −1.1% when zeroed). The blind agent asserted a self-damage consequence the SSOT says an MG cannot have; the driver flagged exactly this as ⚑2 with a measurement recipe.

burst FB+5s 'genuinely lengthens the FB window (more in-FB hits than without it)' — the in-FB hit-count half PASSED (16784 > 15466); the appended expect(BASE.total > NO_FBEXT.total) half fails (447.7M < 477.1M). CLASSIFIED RECON_ERROR: dropping the extend shortens every cycle, yielding 6 casts / 11 FB windows vs 5 / 10, so she gets ~15s more Destroy-Mode + unlimited-ammo uptime — a rotation effect, not a fidelity defect. Total damage is not a valid discriminator for a window-length mechanic; the driver's M5 discriminates on window DURATION (15s on her casts, 10s on helm's, exactly 300 frames of delta) and is green.

Driver override encodes hitRatePct 8.56/15s and flags the consequence as ⚑2; S5 blind independently hit it as a RED (only liter, the AR/SMG consumer, moved when the stat was zeroed — modernia/crown/helm byte-identical).

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA survived. All nine kit lines are FAITHFUL (6) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (3: the fbGate:'inFb' status proxy ⚑3, the Destroy Mode cadence ⚑5, and the verbatim-unmodeled auto-aim clause) → 1.0. Convergence is mechanically RED (27/29 non-skipped S5 assertions green), but both REDs classify as RECON_ERROR against the mechanics SSOT rather than as driver divergences: (1) the blind test assumed Hit Rate lifts Modernia's own damage, which game-mechanics §7 rules out for MG — the driver had already flagged exactly this as ⚑2 with a recipe, and the line's every structural assertion passed; (2) the blind test used total damage to discriminate a window-LENGTH mechanic, and the rotation inverts the monotonicity (removing the +5s yields 6 casts/11 windows vs 5/10, buying more Destroy-Mode uptime) — the driver's window-duration discriminator is the correct observable and is green. Neither was 'fixed' by weakening the model, which is the right call. Independence is real: the cross-family S2b reviewer (fable-5) and the S6 blind override (opus) both converged on the fbGate:'inFb' proxy and the per-hit Destroy Mode reading without seeing the driver, and both independently caught the Max Ammunition ▼ trap and the hits-vs-pulls counter convention. The most valuable thing the driver did is negative: it removed the previously-shipped UNGATED ATK ▲29.38%, which fired from ~3.5s into every fight with no Hit Rate status — a near-permanent over-credit — and it did so on kit text, explicitly not to cool a 1.07-HOT board (n=1). Two residuals for the owner to spot-check, neither verdict-changing. First, a test-coverage hole: no assertion pins the APPLICATION CADENCE of either 200-hit block, so if the engine's hit counter also counted the S1 rider's own damage instances the thresholds would fire ~2× too fast and go undetected; M1's shots×2 pin establishes the counter convention indirectly, but a direct inter-application frame-gap assert would close it. Second, the same-model residual: the S1 rider's flatDamage-vs-extraHitDamagePct fork was chosen for burst-gauge economy (flatDamage emits skillGauge, the passive-buff path emits none), which is SSOT-consistent per game-mechanics §6, but whether an 'additional damage' rider generates gauge per proc in-game is itself unverified (§6 lists per-unit generation quirks as U11c) — and the driver states her measured-exact rotation on graded comps depends on it, so that coupling is worth an owner eye before anyone re-encodes this line. Finally, a documentation nit only: ⚑4 inside the override note still describes the Destroy Mode rider as riding 'the crit:false extraHitDamagePct path', which the caveats array and the shipped behaviour (RIDERCRIT default-ON since 2026-07-22) correctly contradict — stale prose, zero damage impact.
